result.summary: Do not ship: saving settings now silently resets General settings and removes configured search limits.

findings.title: Keep General controls associated with the Save Settings form
findings.body: The new General form closes before the instance form containing the only Save Settings button. Removing the explicit form associations means clicking that button submits no General fields. save_settings in triggarr/web/routes.py:529–539 replaces missing values with defaults and persists them: a configured hard_max_per_cycle of 10 becomes 0 (unlimited), and skip_unreleased=true becomes false. Other General settings also reset, and edits to them cannot be saved through the button. The existing test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form explicitly guards this regression.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the instance form and form="settings-form" on every General control, preserving the separate Security forms.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association and run tests/test_web.py::test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form.
